The document "Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal" (nanolett-6b05174) states that the sodium nucleation overpotential was reduced from 19 mV for bare Al to 12 mV for the carbon/Al current collector.

To find the percentage reduction, we can use the following calculation:

Percentage reduction = ((19 mV - 12 mV) / 19 mV) x 100%
= (7 mV / 19 mV) x 100%
= 36.84%

So, the carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential by approximately 36.84% compared to the bare-Al value.
